note: `Array#join` flattened nested arrays into one list of rendered parts and then put the separator between parts, so an empty nested array dropped the boundary its position earned (`[1, [], 2].join("-")` was `"1-2"` where CRuby answers `"1--2"`). `ary_join_1` appends the separator before every element after the first at each level, so the fix renders each element as a unit and recurses. Covers empty arrays at the start, middle and end, empty separators (where the boundary is invisible), nil elements, deeper nesting, and both the pure and the dispatching (`to_s`/`to_ary`) paths.
